title: Approval Recorder Compatibility Fix
claim: FP-MCP-283 fixes the MCP bridge real-human approval recorder bug: approval scope is no longer hardcoded to FP-MCP-036, executionPacketId can bind approval scope separately from the recorder packet, simple scoped operator chat approval text is accepted, and the approval review window is now two hours.
summary: MCP bridge commit 1821e6f updates src/server.ts and the hardcoded packet-id allowlist. The real approval recorder now supports optional executionPacketId, accepts clear scoped operator approval statements as well as canonical approval text, records whether approval text was canonical or explicit, and extends max approval lifetime from 30 minutes to two hours. Validation passed with pnpm build and pnpm test. No approval artifact, local clearance, approval consumption, disable-switch change, runner contact, or OpenCode action occurred. The active MCP tool surface may need reload before the new schema is visible in ChatGPT.
caveats: Bridge commit 1821e6f may require MCP reload before use.
Previous chat approval should not be silently converted after reload without an explicit scoped recording step.

structuredRecord.validation: pnpm build PASS; pnpm test PASS
